name: Dust Storm
description: A Mars dust storm reduces available power and communications.
outcomes: A storm plan keeps the mission operating.
The storm delays mapping and downlink.

name: Radiation Burst
description: High radiation threatens electronics during the Europa mission.
outcomes: The mission loses science and reliability.

name: Solar Flare
description: A burst of solar activity raises mission risk.
outcomes: The mission loses some power and data margin.
sourceNote: Simplified random event; not live DONKI data.

name: Instrument Fault
description: An instrument needs a recovery procedure.

name: Communications Dropout
outcomes: A strong radio link restores the session.
Queued data waits for the next pass.

name: Power Dip
description: Available power falls below its expected level.
outcomes: Power margin protects the science plan.

name: Budget Cut
outcomes: A low-cost design absorbs the cut.
